seo__search_description: Meet the Oakdene House Foundation team — dedicated people working across counselling, program delivery, operations and practical support in Fairfield, Western Sydney.
hero__intro: The people behind the work at Oakdene House.
intro__intro: Our team brings together care, experience and a deep commitment to community. We work across counselling, program delivery, operations and practical support, with a shared focus on creating a safe and respectful environment for every person who walks through our doors.
closing__text: Behind every Oakdene service is a team that believes support should feel human, respectful and real. We are proud to walk alongside the people and families we serve.
cta__heading: Get in touch with our team
cta__subheading: We are here to help. Reach out and we will find the right next step together.
